summary: Prompt caching breakpoint. As a top-level marker it applies to the last cacheable block.
combines: Thinking-heavy work often outlives the 5-minute lifetime; the docs suggest the 1-hour TTL for long thinking sessions.
Thinking blocks are cached along with tool results automatically during a tool-use loop, even without explicit markers, and count as input tokens when read back.
Any change to thinking mode, `budget_tokens`, effort, structured-output format, or fast-mode speed starts a new cache prefix.
